title: India's GI Ecosystem Surpasses 800 Registered Products; UP Leads Nationally
summary: India's GI Ecosystem Surpasses 800 Registered Products; UP Leads Nationally

items: Ministry of Textiles announced India has over 800 registered GI products (**UP leads with 81 tags**, followed by TN with 76 and Maharashtra with 55).

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
